classificacao.summary: To obtain a fishing license in Brazil through the government's system, follow these key steps: 1) Fill out the application form with accurate personal and fishing-related details. 2) Pay the fee via Pix (preferred for speed) or Boleto (may take up to 3 business days). Ensure Pix payments are made to the correct Tesouro Nacional key to avoid scams. 3) After payment, finalize the process by generating the license through the system. 4) Download and print the license (no physical copy is sent by mail). 5) For a definitive license, submit a request after the provisional license is issued. Common mistakes to avoid: incomplete forms, ignoring the definitive license step, and not verifying payment status. Tips: Print multiple copies for safety and ensure all information is correct to prevent delays. Minors do not require a license, but commercial or regulated fishing may have additional requirements.
